summary: The implementation successfully addresses all core requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-4) with Leaflet.js integration, geolocation tracking, status overlay, and modern design. However, several specific requirement details deviate from the BuildRequest specification.

missing_requirements.reason: The implementation creates a default Leaflet marker without specifying the blue color required by the acceptance criteria. The marker is created via window.L.marker(latlng) without custom icon styling.

missing_requirements.requirement: Status overlay positioned at top-right with 10px from top and right
missing_requirements.reason: The overlay uses Tailwind classes top-4 right-4 which translates to 16px (1rem), not the required 10px positioning.

missing_requirements.requirement: White background with specific shadow 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)
missing_requirements.reason: The status overlay uses Tailwind's bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-sm and shadow-lg which do not match the exact white background and shadow specification. The box-shadow should be 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.2) but uses Tailwind's predefined shadow-lg instead.

missing_requirements.requirement: Box styling with 5px border-radius and specific padding
missing_requirements.reason: The overlay uses Tailwind's rounded-lg (var(--radius) which is 0.625rem = 10px) instead of the required 5px border-radius. Also uses p-4 (16px padding) instead of the required 15px padding.

missing_requirements.requirement: Sans-serif typography specifically Arial font family
missing_requirements.reason: The global styles use a system font stack -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif instead of the specified Arial font.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer component with copyright and caffeine.ai attribution link
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not request a footer component. The implementation adds an unrequested Footer component with copyright, Heart icon, and external link to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking.

hallucinated_features.description: Status overlay includes icons (MapPin, Navigation, AlertCircle) from lucide-react
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not specify icons in the status overlay. Icons are added without being requested in the requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Complex color theming system with OKLCH color space and dark mode support
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specifies a crisp monochrome palette (white UI elements on transparent overlays) for a minimal design, but the implementation includes an extensive theming system with primary, secondary, destructive colors and full dark mode support that goes beyond the requirement.
The BuildRequest does not mention user authentication or Internet Identity. The implementation includes hooks for Internet Identity and authentication actors that are not requested.
